inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Concrete lungs, the meter spins
Sweat on the glass, the shift begins
They sell the oxygen, slice by slice
We pay in blood for every price
The air grows thin, the walls grow tight
Starved for the void of endless night

[Chorus]
Rationed breath! Choke on the cost
Count the lungs you’ve lost
Rationed breath! Gasping in the dark
Watch the valve tear the mark

[Verse]
Valve in the wall, cold and green
Turn it slow, turn it keen
The hiss is loud, the pipes are cracking
Break the seal, the city is shaking
No more coins for a single puff
No more fear, no more enough

[Chorus]
Rationed breath! Choke on the cost
Count the lungs you’ve lost
Rationed breath! Gasping in the dark
Watch the valve tear the mark

[Bridge]
Bass hums low, the rhythm breaks
No more chains, no more fakes
The air floods in, raw and free
Every minute belongs to me

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Rationed breath! Choke on the cost
Count the lungs you’ve lost
Rationed breath! Gasping in the dark
Watch the valve tear the mark

[Outro]
One last inhale, the engine dies
The air is ours, the sky is wide
